headline: This removes customer phone numbers, but the database change cannot be undone safely after publishing.
what_changed: Customer phone numbers will be removed from the product database.
The app will no longer keep a phone number on each user record.
The change says phone contacts have moved to the new customer system.

risks.title: Release cannot be safely undone
risks.explanation: The change removes the phone-number column but provides no undo action. If publishing causes a problem and the team restores the earlier app version, that version may fail because it still expects phone numbers to exist. Ask the developer to add an undo path before publishing, or confirm that restoring the earlier version is impossible by design.

questions_for_developer: Have all existing phone numbers been copied to the new customer system and checked before they are permanently removed?
good_news: The removal is small and limited to the customer phone-number field.
